entities.summary: Kenneth Franklin McKenzie Jr. is a retired United States Marine Corps general who served as the 14th commander of the United States Central Command from March 28, 2019, to April 1, 2022. He served as Director of the Joint Staff from July 5, 2017, after having previously served for two years as Director of Strategic Plans and Policy (J-5) on the Joint Staff.
